I think it depends on what the person is doing, if they say they are doing a review of an item then, I want to know if there is anything that may influance their opinion, ie the creator is their friend, however if they are given a review copy of a game that is "Free" I am fine with that as meny reviews get free copies of games to do a review of them. If you present yourself as a journalist then you should be held to the same standards as every other journalist. If you are doing a vlog about your opinion, go for it but I think you should present the original article or the piece of work you are talking about so people can take a look for themselves.

I am not going to say that everyone on youtube needs to cite their sources like it is a acedemic paper, however there has to be a reasonable amont of ethical standards and practices in place.

Anyone who considers themselves a professional at something should be willing to adhear to some kind of standard and make sure they stick to it.
